traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Zygophyllales page (read 2026-10-16): Zygophyllaceae (~325 spp.) usually opposite; Krameria (18 spp.) spiral.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): usually opposite (decussate not named; inferred from opposite pairs); Krameria spiral (APweb).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Zygophyllales page (read 2026-10-16): Zygophyllaceae usually compound; Krameria simple (or trifoliolate).

traits.division_pattern.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): compound leaves bifoliolate, ternate or paripinnate.

traits.rosette.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): shrubs, trees, herbs with jointed leafy stems.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): herbs usually perennial, some Tribulus, Kallstroemia, Zygophyllum annual; Krameria shrubs.

traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): solitary flowers axillary or leaf-opposed, or terminal; weighting mine.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): regular; APweb: Krameria monosymmetric.

traits.corolla_shape.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): free spreading clawed petals.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Zygophyllales page (read 2026-10-16): all floral parts free apart from the carpels; no hypanthium mentioned.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA Zygophyllaceae (read 2026-10-16): mostly hermaphrodite; Neoluederitzia dioecious.
